169725277.title: File:759th Military Police Battalion conducts Polaris Razor drivers training (9089401).jpg

ImageDescription.value: U.S. Soldiers assigned to the 759th Military Police Battalion, 89th Military Police Brigade, assigned to Joint Task Force–Southern Border, prepare to drive the Polaris Razor (MRZR) vehicles with U.S. Border Patrol agents in Yuma, Ariz., June 5, 2025. MRZR training equips Soldiers with the skills and confidence needed to navigate austere desert environments effectively, ensuring they can support the southern border mission objectives. Under the direction of the U.S. Northern Command, Joint Task Force–Southern Border aligns efforts to seal the southern border and repel illegal activity and is responsible for full-scale, agile, and all-domain operations, which will allow for more effective and efficient DoD operations. (U.S. Army photo by 2nd Lt. Erica Esterly)
